tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: What fekrestan.com is: who it is for (grades 3–9 and their parents), how lessons work, privacy facts, the learning tracks and links to the main public pages. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: The public learning tracks (subjects) with a one-line lead, how many stations are live, and the subject page URL. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: get_subject
tools.description: One track: final goal, phases, pace note, the 30 stations (title, wonder question, public page URL when there is one) and typical milestones. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: get_station_overview
tools.description: One public station page without its worked examples: wonder question, usual grade, concepts, lessons and minutes, idea cards, prerequisites and next stations, safety notes verbatim. tools.name: list_how_to_solve

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the published parent articles by title, description and tags (Persian or Latin words). The query is not stored. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One published parent article: full Markdown text, author, reviewer, dates, cited sources and related articles. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: get_exam_prep_overview
tools.description: The optional exam-prep sections (entry to grade 7 and grade 10): unit families, what each unit trains, how many verified puzzles exist, and the FAQ. No puzzles. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: get_roadmap

tools.name: how_to_start

tools.name: get_access_summary
tools.description: The site's own fixed sentence about cost, verbatim (no prices), and the contact page. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: get_how_we_work
tools.description: How fekrestan's lessons are written and checked: specialised AI agents under the operator's supervision, independent re-solving of every problem, pedagogy and child-safety review, and the privacy facts. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No an

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public pages (parent articles, «روش حل» pages, subject and station pages). Returns ids (URLs) to pass to fetch. The query is not stored. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The text of one public page found with search (id = its URL): an article, a «روش حل» page, a subject or a station page. Same content limits as the other tools. Returns Persian (fa-IR, RTL) text from public fekrestan.com pages for parents and teachers. No answers to in-app exercises.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
